build_norm_layer: build a normalization layer from a config dict with specified type and number of features
infer_abbr: infer the abbreviation string for a given normalization layer class type
is_norm: check if a given PyTorch module is a normalization layer with optional exclusions
register_norm_modules: register standard normalization modules like BN, GN, LN, IN into the MODELS registry
review_norm_registry: review the registered normalization module abbreviations and their mapped PyTorch classes
